gui.colorTheme.label: Theme mode
gui.colorTheme.description: Choose system, light, or dark appearance. System mode follows macOS appearance changes.

gui.accentColor.label: Accent color
gui.accentColor.description: The shared color used for primary actions, active states, and streaming cursors.

gui.navigationDensity.label: Navigation density
gui.navigationDensity.description: Adjust spacing in the DeepCode-GUI rails without changing session data.

gui.showReasoning.label: Reasoning details
gui.showReasoning.description: Click the reasoning status to read reasoning supplied by the model. Off by default; this display preference does not change reasoning effort.

gui.showContextRail.label: Show context rail
gui.showContextRail.description: Show the shared run, tool, and artifact projection in the DeepCode-GUI right rail.

workbench.styleTokenOverrides.label: Custom palette
workbench.styleTokenOverrides.description: Custom light and dark colors. Edit them in Appearance → Colors.

agent.windows.shell.label: Windows shell
agent.windows.shell.description: Applies to subsequent runs. Auto prefers PowerShell 7, then Windows PowerShell. Never switches during execution.

agent.windows.gitBashPath.label: Git Bash path
agent.windows.gitBashPath.description: Optional full path to bash.exe. Leave empty to detect the Git installation.

agent.systemPrompt.label: System prompt
agent.systemPrompt.description: Appended after the built-in coding Agent instruction and shared by new sessions from every UI shell.

agent.permissions.workspaceMutation.label: Workspace changes
agent.permissions.workspaceMutation.description: Choose whether fs.* and workspaceMode=write Bash require Plan confirmation. workspaceMode=read Shell is authorized by the workspace binding; write boundaries and destructive-command hard denials remain active.

agent.permissions.engineeringDecisions.label: Engineering decisions
agent.permissions.engineeringDecisions.description: Choose whether the Agent asks about unclear engineering routes or decides from current code facts. Missing product facts and out-of-workspace actions still require a question.

agent.permissions.networkRead.label: Public network read
agent.permissions.networkRead.description: Default Kernel decision for public search and read tools.

agent.permissions.external.label: Host Shell and external tools
agent.permissions.external.description: Default Kernel decision for executionScope=host Bash and tools contributed by external plugins.

agent.web.search.endpointTemplate.label: Web Search Endpoint Override
agent.web.search.endpointTemplate.description: Leave empty for the built-in Brave Web Search adapter, or provide an explicit JSON HTTP endpoint template containing {query} and optional {limit}. The configured endpoint is never used as fallback.

agent.web.search.authHeaderName.label: Web Search Auth Header
agent.web.search.authHeaderName.description: Header name used only by an explicitly configured search endpoint. The built-in Brave adapter always uses X-Subscription-Token.

agent.documents.pythonPath.label: PDF renderer Python
agent.documents.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter with WeasyPrint installed. Leave empty to use the document runtime environment or system Python. HTML and Markdown export need no extra runtime.

agent.web.search.authSecretRef.label: Web Search Auth Secret
agent.web.search.authSecretRef.description: Secret reference required by the built-in Brave adapter and optional for an explicitly configured search endpoint. Without it, built-in web.search is blocked.

skills.mounts.label: Project Skill Mounts
skills.mounts.description: JSON array of additional Skill mount definitions available to Agent runs.

mcp.servers.label: Project MCP Servers
mcp.servers.description: JSON array of MCP service definitions available to Agent runs.
